# Red Cell Solutions

> A private intelligence cell specializing in Corporate Sabotage & Infiltration Defense. We protect enterprise operations, supply chains, infrastructure, and reputations from coordinated infiltration, corporate espionage, hostile activist disruption, and malicious insider threats — primarily through tactical HUMINT, social engineering/pretexting, and physical red teaming.

Core thesis: We find the way they would get in, then build what stops them.

## Who we serve
- Fortune 500 C-suite leadership
- General Counsel and legal/privileged engagements
- Global and enterprise Security Directors

## Core Capabilities
1. Adversarial Infiltration & Disruption Defense — full-scope simulation of a coordinated adversary against operations, supply chain, and business continuity, followed by a hardening roadmap.
2. Tactical Physical Red Teaming & Penetration — covert facility entry, badge/credential exploitation, tailgating and guard bypass, sensitive-area penetration.
3. Pretexting & Social Engineering Countermeasures — targeted pretexting, vishing/phishing/impersonation, insider-threat elicitation testing, executive protection, and human hardening.

## How we operate
Reconnaissance → Infiltration → Debrief → Hardening. A disciplined cycle repeated until the client is a hard target.
